name: tokyo
description: A real-time 3D model of Tokyo in the browser, compiled from public data with procedural detail on top. Fly over the city, change the time of day, and watch the traffic, the trains and the birds.

paragraphs: A real-time 3D model of Tokyo in the browser, compiled from public data with procedural detail on top. Fly over the city, change the time of day, and watch the traffic, the trains and the birds.

The buildings, roads and terrain are real: they come from Japan's open 3D city model (Project PLATEAU), OpenStreetMap and the national elevation survey. Everything the data does not carry is generated: facades and windows, street furniture, road paint, traffic, night lighting, water, weather.
features: Buildings: real footprints and heights. Central districts use PLATEAU's detailed roof shapes and its aerial

roof photos; walls blend from the (smeared) aerial wall photo at a distance to a generated facade close up. Facades are textured by building use, with windows fitted per wall, interior-mapped rooms, parapets, rooftop…
Ground: terrain from the 5 m elevation model under an aerial photo, PLATEAU road surfaces with kerbs, parks,
woods and water, lane lines, zebra crossings, stop lines, lane arrows, 止まれ and painted speed limits.
